user.title: Consumi luce e gas (SII)
user.description: Portale Consumi only accepts SPID or CIE. With the browser connection you log in to the portal as usual and a bookmark sends the consumption to Home Assistant: no cookie to copy, no stored credentials.

reauth_confirm.title: New login required
reauth_confirm.description: The portal session expired. The browser connection does not expire: it is the recommended way.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect
reconfigure.description: Create a new bookmark (e.g. if the Home Assistant address changed: the previous key stops working) or switch to the cookie.

browser.title: Connect from the browser
browser.description: A page opens with the bookmark «Invia consumi a Home Assistant». Create it, log in to Portale Consumi with SPID or CIE and use it when you see your supplies. This window updates by itself.

cookie.title: Paste the cookie
cookie.description: Advanced mode. After the SPID/CIE login to Portale Consumi: developer tools (F12) → Network → a *Service.json request → Request Headers → Cookie. Home Assistant keeps the session alive with a request every 10 minutes; when it expires it asks for a new login. Never enter SPID or CIE credentials.

error.invalid_session: The portal rejected the session: cookie incomplete or expired.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or read a valid response.
error.no_url: Home Assistant does not know its own address: set it in Settings → System → Network, or use the cookie.

abort.no_points: The portal shows no active supplies for this login.

init.title: Updates
init.description: How often to read consumption with the cookie. The session is kept alive every 10 minutes anyway.

abort.browser_no_options: The browser connection has no options: to update the data log in to Portale Consumi and use the bookmark.
